とらちぃ Sensei, your ryona stuff looks great.

I request a picture showing a revenge story.
A boy is a descendant of a "Yuusha". He goes to a school, disguised as a normal boy who looks quiet and slim.
One day, in the school gym, a cocky girl from his class challenges him in wrestling. This girl is a talented MMA fighter and is stronger than average boys.
The girl defeats him and mocks him.

A few days later, the boy challenges this girl for a rematch in the same gym after everybody goes home.
He transforms into his Yuusha form, an athletic and stronger man, and easily defeats this girl and makes her submit.

The upper half of the image shows the girl defeating the boy, and the bottom half shows the boy's revenge.
Pick any submission holds you like. (For example, the girl wins with a headscissor, and the boy wins with a bear hug).

Please emphasize the facial expressions. Make the girl beg when she loses, and make her say cocky things when she wins.

Thanks.
